title: Momentum and Nesterov
description: Velocity accumulation that damps oscillation across narrow valleys; the Nesterov lookahead variant.

title: RMSProp, Adam and AdamW
description: Per-parameter adaptive step sizes, bias correction of the moment estimates, and decoupled weight decay.

title: Learning-rate schedules and warmup
description: Step, cosine, warmup+cosine and 1cycle schedules; why Adam-style optimisers need warmup.

title: L2, weight decay and L1
description: Penalising weight size; L2 as a Gaussian prior, L1 as a Laplace prior, and their effect on the solution.

title: Dropout
description: Random unit masking during training with inverted scaling so that inference needs no change.

title: Early stopping and data augmentation
description: Regularising through the training procedure and through the data instead of the loss.

title: Variance-preserving initialisation
description: Xavier and He scaling derived from variance propagation, and vanishing/exploding gradient diagnostics.

title: Batch normalisation
description: Normalising each feature over the batch with learned scale and shift; forward, backward, train/eval behaviour.

title: Layer norm and RMSNorm
description: Per-sample normalisation across features, used in transformers; RMSNorm drops the centring.

title: PyTorch in practice
description: Tensors, autograd, nn.Module, DataLoader, the standard training loop, devices, mixed precision, checkpointing.
